REPORT.UNKNOWN_FIELDS: Some fields of the model are not ours. Choose what goes in their place before saving.
REPORT.IMAGE_MISSING: {count} image(s) did not come. Swap them before saving.
REPORT.INVALID: This model could not be checked. Import it again.
REPORT.UNRESOLVED_PARTS: {count} part(s) could not be brought in yet. For now, this design cannot be saved.
REPORT.UNSAFE_REMOVED: We removed code that is not safe in an e-mail.
REPORT.UNSAFE_CSS_REMOVED: We removed styles that are not safe in an e-mail.
REPORT.HIDDEN_TEXT_REMOVED: We removed text that was hidden from the reader.
REPORT.CONDITIONAL_SIMPLIFIED: A part that changed for each person now shows the same text to everyone.
REPORT.TAG_SIMPLIFIED: A field had extra rules. We kept only the field.
REPORT.LINK_REMOVED: {count} link(s) did not work outside the old tool and were removed. The text stayed.
REPORT.REDIRECT_KEPT: Some links pass through a counter of the old tool. Check them.
REPORT.EMBED_REMOVED: We removed a form or embedded content. E-mails do not show them.
REPORT.VIDEO_AS_IMAGE: A video became an image with a link.
REPORT.DARK_MODE_IGNORED: The dark mode colors were not kept.
REPORT.WEB_FONT_IGNORED: A special font was replaced by a font every e-mail shows.
REPORT.STYLES_DROPPED: Some styles could not be kept.
REPORT.INCLUDE_IGNORED: A part that came from another file was left out.
REPORT.CSS_LIMIT: The model had too many styles. We kept the first ones.
REPORT.LAYOUT_STACKED: Some columns were stacked to fit the e-mail.
REPORT.TABLE_AS_TEXT: A table became lines of text.
REPORT.OUTLOOK_ONLY: A part made for one e-mail program only was replaced by the common version.
REPORT.QUALITY_PENDING: Some reading rules could not be fixed on their own. Check the text and the colors.
REPORT.GMAIL_CLIP: The e-mail is long and some e-mail programs may cut it.
REPORT.TEMPLATE_CODE_REMOVED: We removed code of the old tool.
REPORT.UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK_REMOVED: The old unsubscribe link left. Ours is in the footer.
REPORT.UNSUBSCRIBE_TEXT_KEPT: A text about leaving the list stayed. Check it.
REPORT.CHARACTERS_REPLACED: Some letters could not be read and were left out. Check the text.
REPORT.ANIMATION_LOST: An animated image became still to fit the e-mail.
REPORT.SOCIAL_ICON_DEFAULT: A social network icon did not come and went back to the standard one.
REPORT.IMAGE_COMPRESSED: {count} image(s) were made lighter to open fast.
REPORT.TAGS_CONVERTED: Fields like the person's name now work here.
REPORT.PLATFORM_TAGS_REMOVED: We removed fields that only worked in the old tool.
REPORT.FOOTER_REPLACED: The footer is now ours, with the unsubscribe link.
REPORT.TRACKING_REMOVED: We removed the open counters of the old tool.
REPORT.LINK_UNWRAPPED: Links now go straight to the right page.
REPORT.VML_BUTTON_RECOVERED: A button made for one e-mail program was rebuilt.
REPORT.ACCORDION_CONVERTED: Parts that opened on click now show all the text.
REPORT.CAROUSEL_CONVERTED: The image carousel became images one below the other.
REPORT.FONT_REPLACED: The font was changed to Arial so it reads well everywhere.
REPORT.QUALITY_FIXED: We fixed sizes and colors to make it easy to read.
